title: Boston Freedom Trail History Pub Crawl Small-Group Tour
includes: Local Bostonian tour guide and beer expert
Historic pub crawl along the Freedom Trail
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum age is 21 years (must present ID at start of pub crawl)
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Independence Pub Crawl combines Boston’s revolutionary history with four iconic and unique pubs along the Freedom Trail. An expert local guide will share the little-known and hilarious stories of colonial Boston and the American Revolution that the left out of 8th grade history class, all while you enjoy the company of fellow travelers from around the world

The tour lasts 2 hours and 15 minutes and begins at the Sam Adams statue outside Faneuil Hall. Walking is limited to a couple of blocks, allowing guests of all physical capabilities to enjoy the tour. Drinks are not included in the ticket price and are available for purchase separately at each pub, so you can choose exactly what you would like to enjoy.

Come laugh, learn, and raise a glass to Boston’s rebellious past. Cheers!
